conflict_resolutions.EMPTY_CATALOG_NOTE_DOES_NOT_ESTABLISH_CU: The Federal Register catalog observation for EO 13646 has an empty note, so it shows neither that the order ended nor that it continues. I did not use it. The status rests on section 6 of the held original (the Council terminates 2 years after June 25, 2013 unless extended by the President) and on the bounded searches, which found no extension, amendment or revocation; the U.S. Code printing of the order in 20 U.S.C. 9701 note carries no statement that the Council continues.

notice: Producer research decision only. Independent review and owner adoption remain separate.
rationale: Executive Order 13646 (June 25, 2013; 78 FR 39159) creates the President's Advisory Council on Financial Capability for Young Americans and provides in section 6 that, unless extended by the President, the Council terminates 2 years after the date of the order, that is on June 25, 2015 (inclusive; the exclusive reading is the start of that day). The own-terms record TERM:EO:13646:f9d137d63abc3cc2@d675de17a58e8e46 quotes that wording from the held original. No instrument extending the Council is held, the catalog note is empty and the bounded searches found none; a June 8, 2015 Treasury notice shows the Council still meeting on June 17, 2015 to vote on final recommendations, which is consistent with a scheduled end. The 20 U.S.C. 9701 note only prints the order's text. The order has no operative force on 2026-10-14.
